{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Verify the actual values in the 'severity' column (case-sensitive)
severity_unique = df['severity'].unique()
print(f'Unique severity values (case-sensitive): {severity_unique}')

# Case-insensitive filter for 'severe' patients
severe_patients = df[(df['severity'].str.lower() == 'severe') & (df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0)]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for valid SEVERE patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the number of valid SEVERE patients and the mean
len_severe_valid = len(severe_patients)
print(f'Number of valid SEVERE patients (case-insensitive): {len_severe_valid}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_biomarker_severe}')"}
